title: HPV series by age 13 (routine 11-12)

source.quote: HPV vaccination routinely recommended at age 11–12 years

denominator.quote: catch-up HPV vaccination recommended for all persons through age 18 years

derived.min: routine series is at 11–12 years; a patient is only overdue once past that window, i.e. from 13

numerator.quote: Age 9–14 years at initial vaccination: 2-dose series

gold_notes: Footnote limitation: 3 doses are needed if dose 1 was at age >=15 -- dose count depends on age at first dose, not expressible in the grammar. min_count 2 is a lower bound.
